permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Calculate routes with the free OpenStreetMap routing server of FOSSGIS e.V., search places with Photon (komoot), and load the streets of the overview map from OpenStreetMap via the public Overpass API (overpass-api.de), or use your own servers if you set them up.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Route from where you are and show how far the next turn is. Your position is never stored.
